messages:
Nina (CS): HarborPoint week0 recap: SOC raised two blockers: 1) want signed TLS cert on Splunk HEC + fingerprint proof for our forwarder, 2) want assurance of zero-event-loss during key rotation. They said if unresolved we'll hit their procurement pause. tagging @Bea and @Arun.

Arun (Solutions): i can run a short cert proof: generate signed client cert, show HEC handshake and thumbprint. also can script a 48h replay from s3 to the staging HEC so they can validate event counts. need creds to staging.

Bea (Security): for key rotation concern we should offer a holdback policy: we run rotation in a maintenance window with dual-key decrypt ability for 72h. i'll draft the key-policy snippet that allows decrypt by our forwarder role and their audit-read role, plus a rotation timeline note.

Diego (Ops): FYI during internal sim we saw a 1.2% duplicate event rate when checkpointing failed; fixed by atomic writes and idempotency keys. i'll add an idempotency step to the runbook and include a verification script that prints counts before/after replay. snippet: 
```
# verification check (pseudo)
events_before=$(aws s3 ls s3://harborpoint-cloudtrail/ --recursive | wc -l)
replay_to_hec --from s3 --to https://staging-hec.harborpoint.local
events_after_query=$(splunk search "index=cloudtrail earliest=-2d@d" | count)
if [ "$events_before" -ne "$events_after_query" ]; then echo "mismatch"; fi
```

Nina (CS): action items: @Arun - run cert handshake proof + replay to staging by EOD tomorrow. @Bea - post key rotation holdback policy + policy snippet. @Diego - add idempotency verification and runbook diff. @Marta - flag renewal watch until we get SOC signoff.

infra-bot: Reminder: HarborPoint week0 follow-up meeting scheduled 1749999600.

Marta (Renewals): noted, i'll schedule a check-in with procurement after the replay. if any objections remain i'll request a brief exec call.

Arun (Solutions): i've requested staging creds from customer, they answered that operations will post an S3 presigned for the replay. i'll post results here when done.

Bea (Security): drafting key policy (redacted): {\"Version\":\"2012-10-17\",\"Statement\":[{\"Sid\":\"AllowForwarderAndAuditRole\",\"Effect\":\"Allow\",\"Principal\":{\"AWS\":\"arn:aws:iam::555000666777:role/harbor-forwarder\"},\"Action\":[\"kms:Decrypt\",\"kms:GenerateDataKey\"],\"Condition\":{\"StringEquals\":{\"aws:SourceVpc\":\"vpc-0deadbeef\"}}}]}

Diego (Ops): i'll run the replay once we have presigned URL and post the Splunk counts + any error lines.

Nina (CS): thanks team. keeping thread open — will escalate if we don't have signed audit evidence by EOD Fri.
